name: unifi-network-pp-mcp
description: Every UniFi Network API operation, plus drift detection, topology, and rule prediction no other UniFi tool has.

unifi_api_key.title: UniFi API key
unifi_api_key.description: Local API key from the gateway UI: Settings > Control Plane > Integrations > Create API Key.

unifi_gateway_host.title: Gateway host
unifi_gateway_host.description: Hostname or IP of the UniFi OS gateway on your network, e.g. 10.0.0.1 (the CLI adds the /proxy/network prefix).

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

unifi_base_path.title: API base path
unifi_base_path.description: Path segment appended to the gateway host, when your controller does not serve the Network API at the standard location. Leave blank for a stock UniFi OS gateway.

unifi_base_url.title: UniFi API base URL
unifi_base_url.description: Full API base URL, e.g. https://10.0.0.1/proxy/network. Leave blank when you set the gateway host above; the CLI builds this from it.
